translations.web: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.
translations.bsb: And the pig, though it has a split hoof completely divided, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.
translations.kjv: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean
translations.asv: And the swine, because he parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you.
